brand.tagline: Click the map for every district you're in, and who represents you.

head.title: What district am I in? Find your Wisconsin district — districtry Wisconsin
head.description: Enter an address or ZIP — or tap the map — to find your district: county, city, village or town, school district, Wisconsin Senate and Assembly districts, U.S. House district, and who represents you. Free, no login.
head.og_title: What district am I in? — districtry Wisconsin
head.og_description: Click the map or search any Wisconsin address to see every civic district that covers it, and who represents you.
head.og_image_alt: districtry Wisconsin — a map of Wisconsin with the question: which districts cover this point, and who represents you?
head.twitter_title: What district am I in? — districtry Wisconsin
head.twitter_description: See every civic district that covers a Wisconsin address, and who represents you.

geometry.note: State outline dissolved from TIGERweb by bootstrap_state.py; drives the out-of-scope wash.
Every county in the state, pre-built from TIGERweb by bootstrap_state.py (bounds tightened to the real count at bootstrap).
The state's U.S. House districts, pre-built from TIGERweb by bootstrap_state.py (bounds tightened at bootstrap).
The state's unified school districts, pre-built from TIGERweb by bootstrap_state.py (bounds tightened at bootstrap).
The 33 State Senate districts plus TIGERweb's ZZ water pseudo-district, pre-built by wi/scripts/build_legislative_boundaries.py (2,000-point agreement gate).
The 99 State Assembly districts plus TIGERweb's ZZ water pseudo-district, pre-built by wi/scripts/build_legislative_boundaries.py (2,000-point agreement gate).

rosters.note: U.S. House roster for the state, built from unitedstates/congress-legislators by bootstrap_state.py and refreshed weekly by update-wi-congress-roster.yml (min tightened at bootstrap).
State Senate roster from the Open States current-people export (wi.csv), refreshed weekly by update-wi-legislature-roster.yml; the floor tolerates transient vacancies (33 seats).
State Assembly roster from the Open States current-people export (wi.csv), refreshed weekly by update-wi-legislature-roster.yml; the floor tolerates transient vacancies (99 seats).
The Data gaps panel's content; seeded minimal by bootstrap_state.py, grown as the fork records real gaps.

data_sources.note: The machine-checked source manifest lives in the freshness gate; the template ships it scaffolded with the five starter layers' endpoints, and the fork grows it with every layer it adds.

notes.accent: brand-600 — buttons, links, pills, checked states
notes.accent_deep: brand-700 — text and links on light
notes.accent_warm: the mark's magenta polygon — Public Safety group dot + focus ring; a DISTINCT hue is required, not preferred, because the engine paints four group dots and violet in both slots would make two identical
